notices.title: Notice of Consumer's Right to Receive Lien Waivers, as a separate document
notices.trigger: Home improvement contract; given before the buyer and seller enter into the contract, and the seller keeps evidence the buyer received it
notices.format: In writing, the verbatim statement only, as a separate document, in a clear and conspicuous font, in a format the buyer can retain
notices.support: The notice shall be provided as a separate document, written in a clear and conspicuous font, in a format that the buyer can retain.
notices.summary_row: Home Improvement Practices, whole chapter (110.01 to 110.09) incl. lien waiver notice 110.025, contract contents 110.05, note legend 110.06, cancellation 110.07
notices.start: Notice of Consumer’s Right to Receive Lien Waivers
notices.quote_note: No quotation marks; the rule says the notice consists of 'the following, verbatim statement' and the statement follows set off, headed by its own title (included).
notices.boundary_unsure: None. Title line through the contact line; stored not printed because the rule requires it as a separate document given before the contract.

notices.trigger: Prime contractor who has contracted or will contract with subcontractors, suppliers or service providers, under a written contract with the owner; if no written contract, a separate notice within 10 days after the first labor or materials; exceptions in 779.02(1)
notices.format: Included in the written contract and a copy of the contract given to the owner; at least 8-point bold type if printed, or capital letters if typewritten; substantially the stated language
notices.support: shall be in at least 8-point bold type, if printed, or in capital letters, if typewritten
notices.start: As required by the Wisconsin construction lien law
notices.quote_note: The statute's opening curly quotation mark before As and its closing curly quotation mark after 'duly paid' are excluded: markers lie inside them. The statute prints its period after the closing mark, so the cut ends without a period.
notices.boundary_unsure: None on the edges (quoted). The notice is needed only where the prime contractor uses subcontractors, suppliers or service providers and no sub. (1) exception applies, which the builder cannot tell; set to print for every contract as the notice is harmless where not needed. Stored, not printed: the trigger (prime contractor who uses subcontractors, with exceptions) is not something the builder knows.

notices.trigger: Contract to construct or remodel a dwelling (pools, hardscape, porches, garages and basements are in; repair or maintenance only jobs are out); delivered before entering a written contract, or before work starts if the contract is oral
notices.format: Notice worded substantially as given, conspicuous and in writing, may be included within the contract; delivered together with a copy of the DSPS brochure
notices.support: The notice required under par. (a) shall be conspicuous and in writing and may be included within the contract between the contractor and the consumer.
notices.summary_row: Notice Concerning Construction Defects (contract or separate)
notices.end: All parties are bound by applicable warranty provisions.
notices.quote_note: No quotation marks; the notice is the heading and paragraph set off after 'a notice worded substantially as follows:' (heading included).
notices.boundary_unsure: None. Stored not printed because it applies only to a contract to construct or remodel a dwelling (not maintenance or repair only), which the builder cannot tell, and it is delivered with a brochure.

notices.title: Right to Cure brochure (DSPS form SBD-10845) handed over with the defect notice
notices.trigger: Contract to construct or remodel a dwelling; delivered with the Notice Concerning Construction Defects
notices.format: Hand over the state's own PDF, not retyped text; the only copy is a City of Verona copy, revision R08/14, and the current revision is unconfirmed
notices.support: Someone should get the current PDF from DSPS directly before the product ships it.
notices.summary_row: Right-to-cure brochure that must be handed over with it

notices.trigger: Consumer approval transaction: solicited face to face away from the merchant's regular place of business, or by mail or telephone, and signed away from it, on credit or cash over $25
notices.format: Two copies of a typed or printed notice in capital and lowercase letters of not less than 12-point boldface, under the conspicuous caption CUSTOMER'S RIGHT TO CANCEL; also in the other language when the merchant regularly uses it and the customer's principal language is that language; a federal cancellation form is accepted
notices.support: Compliance with requirements of federal statutes, rules or regulations governing form of notice of right of cancellation, in consumer approval transactions otherwise subject to this chapter, shall be deemed to satisfy the notice requirements of this chapter.
notices.start: You may cancel this agreement by mailing a written notice
notices.end: provided by the seller for your records.
notices.quote_note: No outer quotation marks (the statute says 'Read as follows:'). The inner curly quotation marks around I hereby cancel are the statute's own and stay.
blanks: (insert name and mailing address of seller)
notices.boundary_unsure: None. Caption is its own notice, WI-cancel-caption. The statute requires 2 copies on a page the customer can use as the notice, bilingual when the merchant regularly uses another language, delivery after the credit disclosures; those are layout/process, not triggers.

notices.title: Caption CUSTOMER'S RIGHT TO CANCEL above the notice
notices.trigger: Consumer approval transaction: solicited face to face away from the merchant's regular place of business, or by mail or telephone, and signed away from it, on credit or cash over $25
notices.format: Conspicuous caption over the notice, capital and lowercase letters in not less than 12-point boldface type
notices.support: Appear under the conspicuous caption: “CUSTOMER’S RIGHT TO CANCEL”
notices.quote_note: The statute's curly quotation marks around the caption are excluded (markers lie inside them); the apostrophe in CUSTOMER’S is the statute's curly one.

notices.title: Lien notice a non-prime claimant serves on the owner
notices.trigger: Subcontractor or supplier (not the prime contractor) serving notice on the owner within 60 days of first work
notices.format: Written notice in 2 signed copies, substantially in the stated language with blanks accurately filled in
notices.support: The notice to the owner shall be in substantially the following language, with blanks accurately filled in
notices.summary_row: Home Improvement Practices, whole chapter (110.01 to 110.09) incl. lien waiver notice 110.025, contract contents 110.05, note legend 110.06, cancellation 110.07
notices.start: As a part of your construction contract, your prime contractor
notices.quote_note: The statute's opening and closing curly quotation marks are excluded: markers lie inside them; the period follows the closing mark and is excluded.
blanks: .... (give legal description, street address or other clear description)
notices.boundary_unsure: None. A claimant's notice, not part of the prime contract: stored only.

notices.title: Legend on a home improvement promissory note or instrument
notices.trigger: Any promissory note or instrument (other than a check) used with a home improvement contract
notices.format: In contrasting bold-face type on the note
notices.support: No seller shall use any promissory note or instrument, other than a check, in connection to a home improvement contract unless it bears the following statement in contrasting bold-face type
notices.summary_row: Home Improvement Practices, whole chapter (110.01 to 110.09) incl. lien waiver notice 110.025, contract contents 110.05, note legend 110.06, cancellation 110.07
notices.start: This is a home improvement instrument and is non-negotiable.
notices.end: Every holder takes subject to claims and defenses of the maker or obligor.
notices.quote_note: The statute's opening and closing curly quotation marks are excluded: markers lie inside them.
notices.boundary_unsure: None. Goes on a note, not in the contract: stored only.

notices.title: Basement waterproofing: no-guarantee disclaimer
notices.trigger: Basement waterproofing contract where the seller's services are not guaranteed
notices.format: On the face of the contract, separate from other provisions, in bold face type
notices.support: which shall be set forth on the face of the contract, separate and apart from all other contract provisions, and in bold face type
notices.summary_row: Home Improvement Practices, whole chapter (110.01 to 110.09) incl. lien waiver notice 110.025, contract contents 110.05, note legend 110.06, cancellation 110.07
notices.start: THE BASEMENT WATERPROOFING SERVICES PROVIDED BY THIS CONTRACT
notices.quote_note: The statute's opening and closing curly quotation marks are excluded: markers lie inside them.
notices.boundary_unsure: None. Stored: applies only to basement waterproofing jobs with no guarantee, which the builder cannot tell.

notices.title: Basement waterproofing: dampness exclusion statement
notices.trigger: Basement waterproofing guarantee that excludes basement dampness, if the buyer agrees in writing
notices.format: In bold face type in the guarantee or the contract
notices.support: the guarantee or contract contains the following statement in bold face type
notices.summary_row: Home Improvement Practices, whole chapter (110.01 to 110.09) incl. lien waiver notice 110.025, contract contents 110.05, note legend 110.06, cancellation 110.07
notices.start: THE GUARANTEE PROVIDED HEREIN DOES NOT COVER DAMPNESS
notices.end: IT DOES COVER ANY WATER LEAKAGE OR FLOW.
notices.quote_note: The statute's opening and closing curly quotation marks are excluded: markers lie inside them.
notices.boundary_unsure: None. Stored: optional, only for basement waterproofing guarantees.

changes.new: The three business days run from when the merchant gives the CUSTOMER'S RIGHT TO CANCEL notice, so a missing notice leaves the right open; the customer cancels by mail, effective when mailed.
changes.support: the three business days run from when the merchant gives the 423.203 notice, so a missing notice leaves the right open

changes.new: Consumer approval transactions (solicited face to face away from the merchant's regular place of business, or by mail or telephone, and signed away from it, on credit or cash over $25); a home improvement contract that is one must comply with ch. 423 (ATCP 110.08), on top of the federal rule
895.07: 90 working days before suit; repose 7 years (893.89)
ATCP 110.025 lien waiver notice, verbatim, as a separate document given before the contract; keep evidence the buyer received it
changes.support: The seller shall retain evidence of the buyer’s acknowledgement of receipt of the notice.

changes.new: 101.148 defect notice with the DSPS brochure; 423.203 CUSTOMER'S RIGHT TO CANCEL notice in 2 copies, 12 point bold, also in the other language when the merchant regularly uses it and the customer's principal language is that language
changes.support: The bilingual rule (423.203(2)) is triggered by the merchant regularly using another language in advertising, forms or face-to-face negotiations AND the customer's principal language being that language.

unsure: WI-brochure: added because 101.148(2)(a) requires the brochure to be delivered with the notice, but the only copy in the file is a city copy (VERBATIM-SECONDARY), so no text is loaded.
WI-cancel: the cite on the existing entry was 423.202 but the notice wording is in 423.203, so I changed the cite to 423.203; 423.202.
WI-lien-waiver: ATCP 110.025 reaches home improvement, which excludes new residences and major renovations, a distinction the builder cannot decide.

WI-lien: printed for every contract (applies {}); the statute requires it only for a prime contractor who uses subcontractors, suppliers or service providers and no 779.02(1) exception applies. Not decidable by the builder; printing it is harmless where not needed.

WI-cancel and WI-cancel-caption: print for sold_in_home; a consumer approval transaction also includes mail and telephone sales. The notice must be given in 2 copies, after the credit disclosures, and bilingual when 423.203(2) applies: layout and process, not decided here.

WI-defect and WI-lien-waiver: stored (on_file); defect applies to construct or remodel only, and the lien waiver notice must be a separate document. WI-lien-claimant, WI-note-legend, WI-waterproof-noguarantee, WI-waterproof-dampness: new, stored only (not contract text for every job).
